heading: Tata Trusts hires top lawyer Abhishek Singhvi as drawn out legal battle looms: Shareholder rights cannot be ‘nullified’
author: LiveMint Editorial
paragraphs: As legal tensions rise between Tata Sons and its majority shareholder, top lawyer Abhishek Singhvi has been appointed as the legal representative of Tata Trusts. Here's what he said about the ongoing dispute.
